title: 2018 Panini Prizm #24 Chris Carson Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2018 Panini Prizm trading card features Chris Carson from the National Football League (NFL). It is part of the modern (1970-Now) era and is a single card from the base set. The card is in near mint/mint condition and has the Prizm parallel/variety.

The card number is 24 and is manufactured by Panini Group. It is a sports trading card for football enthusiasts and fans of Chris Carson. This card is a great addition to any collection and is sure to impress.
